subject: Toolsmith connector: LlamaIndex adapter + observability scoping
messages:
From: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@toolsmith.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + integration idea: Toolsmith connector for LlamaIndex + tracing hooks

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks for taking a quick look. I'm Oliver from Toolsmith's partnerships team — we build developer tooling for observability and SDK integrations for LLM ecosystems. Attached is a short deck that outlines a prototype connector we'd like to build:

- LlamaIndex adapter that routes index calls to our caching layer
- Lightweight tracing hooks that emit spans for request latency/KV cache hits
- Optional server-side SDK instrumentation for Redwood's runtime

We think there are clear joint customer motions: ISVs who embed LlamaIndex + Redwood can get better observability and reduced token spend with our cache. Would you be open to a 30m scoping call next week to map requirements (security, network, SDK surface) and a mutual action plan?

Proposed slots: Tue 1/5 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 1/6 11:00–11:30 PT. Calendly link included below.

Attachment: toolsmith-integration-deck.pdf

Cheers,
Oliver Schmidt
Partnerships, Toolsmith, Inc.
partners@toolsmith.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@toolsmith.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + integration idea: Toolsmith connector for LlamaIndex + tracing hooks

Hi Oliver — thanks for the deck, looks interesting.

Short answers up front: yes, we should scope this. Quick asks before the call so we can come prepared:
- A brief security checklist (SOC2 type, data retention, any PII handling) — even a one-page summary is helpful
- A simple diagram of the proposed call flow (client -> LlamaIndex -> Redwood -> Toolsmith cache/tracing)
- Any constraints on sandbox API keys or rate limits for early testing

I can take the lead on product/partner coordination. Marissa will own the runtime/observability acceptance criteria.

Tue 1/5 10:00 PT works for me. If that still works for you, I'll send a calendar invite and a short draft agenda.

A couple of agenda items we want covered:
- Security & compliance checklist
- Minimal SDK surface + config flags for caching/tracing
- Sandbox access and SLOs for test traffic
- Mutual action plan and high-level timelines

Attachment: prelim-questions.txt

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@toolsmith.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + integration idea: Toolsmith connector for LlamaIndex + tracing hooks

Thanks — looping Marcus (runtime lead) into the thread. Quick draft mutual action plan so we can use the call to align and convert into an SOW after: 

1) Discovery (this week) — finalize security checklist, API surface, and test data scope (owner: Toolsmith)
2) Prototype (2–3 weeks) — implementation of LlamaIndex adapter + basic tracing span emitter; Redwood provides sandbox GPU endpoint and sandbox API keys (owner: Redwood/Marcus)
3) Eval & perf (1 week) — shared prompt set, perf targets for p99 latency and token delta; observability dashboards (owner: Redwood/Marissa + Toolsmith)
4) SOW & pilot (post-eval) — commercial terms + support SLA

Action items for the call:
- Oliver: share the security checklist and the call flow diagram ahead of the meeting
- Oliver: confirm whether Toolsmith needs direct access to Redwood logs or if span exports are sufficient
- Marcus: I'll prepare a short note about acceptable latency impact and test harness (we'll bring sample traffic)

We will draft a light SOW template during the call — attaching a placeholder SOW we use for early ISV pilots (SOW_draft.docx).

On quoting your earlier note: 
> We think there are clear joint customer motions...

Yep — we see overlap with a few ISV customers already evaluating caching strategies.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@toolsmith.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, partners@toolsmith.io
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + integration idea: Toolsmith connector for LlamaIndex + tracing hooks

Hi all — thanks for the fast turnaround. Tue 1/5 slot at 10:00 PT looks OK for some of our engineers; to avoid juggling, can we move to Wed 1/6 11:00 PT? I just booked a 30m on Calendly: https://calendly.com/toolsmith/rdw-integration-call

I've attached the security checklist and the API scope CSV we reference during eng prework. We are happy to emit spans to your OTLP endpoint rather than ask for log access — that should keep the security review simpler.

Attachments: api-scope.csv, toolsmith-security-checklist.pdf

Looking forward — we'll have our SDK engineer on the call and a short demo of the adapter prototype.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Schmidt
Partnerships, Toolsmith, Inc.
oliver.schmidt@toolsmith.io
